common_direction.format: One complete generated 16:9 frame per asset. Target 3840x2160; delivery 1920x1080. Model capability must be checked before quoting. No editor-native replacement graphics or post-added text.
common_direction.identity: WHAT IT COST: cinematic charcoal/black, warm paper, restrained red accent, rare gold. Varied evidence-desk, spatial, architectural and diagram compositions; not a repeating title-card template. English display lettering with Bebas Neue-like condensed headline and Inter-like supporting type.
common_direction.text: visible_text is the exact allowed display copy, not a quotation from a source. Render all lettering inside the generated frame. No invented quotes, unreadable fake legal body copy, signatures, seals, judges, branded screenshots or fabricated Steam messages. Text is editorial, not narration subtitles.
common_direction.provenance: All frames are illustrations. RECREATED_DOCUMENT frames must visibly include RECREATION / NOT AN ORIGINAL DOCUMENT. Other narrative frames must visibly include ILLUSTRATION. These labels are additional mandatory English display copy. No image is evidence; source_ids and claim_ids in the derived manifest point to the real evidence.
common_direction.safe_area: At 1920x1080 keep all essential narrative text and labels inside x=154..1766,y=108..820; lower20% (y>=864) contains no essential content. Keep critical subject in central9:16 crop where feasible, but do not promise automatic vertical usability.
common_direction.editing: Reuse means the identical generated image, not a newly generated variation. A stable hold or slow single-axis detail move may expose an already present detail. No shake, alternating crop jumps, text swaps, invented highlights or mandatory motion. Timing/cuts remain provisional; no audio edits.
common_direction.legal: Maintain party attribution, dates, cohort boundaries, preliminary/as-applied findings and conditional appeal posture. $20M unverified; >$3000 claimed/disputed; 118 not explicit rejection; 4991 not wins or current active cases; district stay not universal arbitration stay.
